candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so anyone can change owner.
Replace the assignment `owner = _owner` with a different hardcoded address so owner is never set to the argument.
Replace `require(msg.sender == admin` with `require(msg.sender == owner` so the check passes for the current owner instead of admin.
Delete the require statement inside onlyAdmin so the modifier always passes.
Return false instead of true on success.
Return an always-reverting value by replacing 'return true' with 'require(false)'.
Delete the return statement so the function returns the default false.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = payable(_owner);` — no semantic difference, excluded. Replace with `owner = address(0);` instead to always set owner to zero address.
Replace `return true;` with `return false;` — observable difference in return value after `setOwner` call.
Delete the statement `owner = _owner;` — owner no longer updated, state variable `owner` differs after call.
Remove `onlyAdmin` modifier from `setOwner` — allows anyone to change owner, observable via public `owner` variable.
Replace `require(msg.sender == admin, ...)` with `require(true, ...)` — bypass admin check entirely.
